title: The Monsoon of Mount Kessler
premise: When a freak low tide exposes the mouth of a sea cave on the Kessler coast, riverboat captain Jonah Sterling discovers the wreck of the Meridian Star—and evidence that his late mother, a salvager everyone called a thief, was actually framed for stealing its cargo. Racing a rival salvage fleet and the incoming monsoon, Jonah must decode his mother's tide charts with the help of Mara Voss, the fleet's disillusioned navigator and the daughter of the man who ruined his mother. In the final confrontation inside the flooding cave, Jonah chooses truth over treasure, vindicating his mother at the cost of the salvage rights he came for, and finds that stopping—for Mara, and for the truth—costs less than running ever did.
about_author: Ulyana Joubert is a former merchant marine navigator who spent a decade working the monsoon coasts of the western Pacific before turning to writing full-time. She lives in a converted lighthouse keeper's cottage, where she still checks the tide tables every morning out of habit.

chapters.title: The Sandbar's Mood
chapters.summary: Jonah Sterling pilots his aging riverboat through a dying port town, establishing his restless philosophy: never stop, never owe. A letter arrives posthumously from his mother—a salvager who drowned in disgrace—containing a tide chart marked with coordinates he's never seen. POV: Jonah. Emotional beat: the ache of a man who inherits only questions.

chapters.title: Six Tides
chapters.summary: The freak low tide reveals the sea cave mouth, and inside, the unmistakable outline of the Meridian Star, lost forty years. Jonah also spots the rival salvage fleet anchoring in the bay—led by Edmund Voss, the man who testified against his mother. POV: Jonah. Emotional beat: awe curdling into urgency; the race begins.

chapters.title: The Navigator's Doubt
chapters.summary: Mara Voss, Edmund's daughter and the fleet's navigator, secretly questions her father's account of the Meridian Star's sinking—his numbers have never matched the wreck's position. She encounters Jonah scavenging the shallows and, rather than report him, trades information. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: the first fracture in a lifetime of loyalty.

chapters.title: Charts Drawn in Salt
chapters.summary: Jonah deciphers his mother's tide chart: the cave floods completely in six tides, and the wreck's cargo hold is only reachable through a submerged passage on the third tide. He realizes his mother died trying to reach it. POV: Jonah. Emotional beat: grief transformed into purpose; the inheritance was never gold, but the knowledge to reach it.

chapters.title: What Edmund Knew
chapters.summary: Mara searches her father's cabin and finds an old insurance claim suggesting he falsified the wreck report to bury evidence that the Meridian Star's cargo was contraband he himself arranged. She confronts him; he deflects with warnings about Jonah's mother. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: duty and love begin pulling in opposite directions.

chapters.title: Third Tide, Rising
chapters.summary: Jonah and Mara, now uneasy allies, dive the submerged passage on the third tide and reach the hold—finding not treasure but the captain's log, which names Edmund Voss and proves Jonah's mother was silenced, not thieving. They barely escape as the passage closes. POV: alternating Jonah and Mara. Emotional beat: triumph shadowed by dread—the log is proof, but proof needs a witness.

chapters.title: The Fleet Weighs Anchor
chapters.summary: Edmund discovers Mara's betrayal and orders the fleet to blast the cave open, monsoon or not. Jonah's boat is sabotaged, stranding them as the first storm bands hit the coast. POV: Jonah, with a brief Edmund interlude. Emotional beat: betrayal at the worst hour; the race collapses into survival.

chapters.title: Landfall
chapters.summary: The monsoon makes landfall early. Jonah and Mara repair the boat in a drowning harbor and choose to sail into the storm to reach the cave before Edmund's explosives do—because if the cave collapses, the truth dies with it. POV: Jonah and Mara. Emotional beat: fear transmuted into resolve; love declared not in words but in the choice to steer together.

chapters.title: The Cave Gives Up Its Dead
chapters.summary: Climax: inside the flooding cave, Jonah reaches the wreck's strongroom as Edmund's crew breaks through the other side. In the rising water, Edmund confesses everything, and Mara records it. Edmund, refusing rescue as the cave floods, is last seen at his son's—Jonah's mother's—old dive site. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: catharsis; the truth costs everything except what matters.

chapters.title: What the Tide Returns
chapters.summary: Resolution: the storm passes. Jonah surrenders the salvage claim, keeping only the captain's log and his mother's cleared name. Mara leaves the fleet. Together they moor his repaired boat at the port he always avoided—and stay. POV: Jonah. Emotional beat: stillness earned; stopping, at last, costs less than running.
